origin.details: ICU sort-key bytes without the terminating NUL. A leading BOM stays in the key. Unsigned byte order matches stri_cmp. One leading U+FEFF is removed before compare, sort, order, rank, unique, and duplicated, and the strings those functions return are stripped. stri_sort_key keeps that character and drops only the terminating NUL of the ICU key.
